name: vagus-workspace
description: Multi-Agent desktop workspace for local Agent sessions

scripts.build:contracts: npm run build --workspace=@vagus/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@vagus/agent-core
scripts.typecheck:contracts: npm run build --workspace=@vagus/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@vagus/agent-core
scripts.build:host: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@vagus/host
scripts.smoke:pi: npm run build:host && npm run smoke:pi --workspace=@vagus/host
scripts.profile:stage-one: npm run build:host && npm run build:app && node scripts/profile-stage-one.mjs
scripts.test:stage-one: npm run build:host && npm run build:client && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:stage-one:native: npm run build:host && npm run bundle:desktop --workspace=@vagus/host && npm run build:app && node scripts/native-stage-one.mjs
scripts.test:stage-three:native: npm run build:host && npm run bundle:desktop --workspace=@vagus/host && npm run build:app && node scripts/native-stage-one.mjs .tmp/native-stage-three.json
scripts.build:app: npm run build:client && npm run build --workspace=@vagus/app
scripts.dev: npm run build:host && npm run build:client && npm run bundle:desktop --workspace=@vagus/host && npm run dev --workspace=@vagus/desktop
